options.label: Around the table

raised.raise: Use decisive type scale, with instructions kept subordinate.
Make each player's place in the turn order explicit.
Use unmistakable selected and unselected card states.
Keep a consistent visual rhythm across every game state.
Make the next action obvious at every stage.
Keep room codes and player counts easy to find.
